evidence: Matches the Descriptors label and touches descriptor management in src/script/descriptor.{cpp,h}, specifically to enable key expression validation for wallet and GUI multisig setup (#35645).
rationale: Exposes descriptor key parsing and key origin retrieval needed by GUI wallet setup wizards to validate user inputs (#35645), and fixes trailing character handling in musig() descriptor parsing. While helpful for unblocking multisig GUI wallet creation workflows, it does not address critical fund safety or major wallet regressions, making it deferrable to higher-priority wallet work.
